# Reproducible Calculus Workflow

This R Markdown-style report demonstrates how executable analysis can keep prose, equations, code, tables, and review warnings together.

```{r}
workflow_outputs <- data.frame(
  artifact_name = c("parameter_records", "workflow_artifacts", "reproducibility_audit"),
  artifact_type = c("csv", "json", "markdown"),
  source_or_generated = c("source", "generated", "generated"),
  warning = c(
    "Parameter records do not prove empirical correctness.",
    "Structured metadata must remain synchronized with generated outputs.",
    "Audit summaries support review but do not replace inspection."
  )
)
workflow_outputs
```

## Interpretation

Executable reports support reproducibility only when outputs can be regenerated from source, assumptions are visible, and warnings remain attached to interpretation.
